filesystem.description: Official MCP filesystem server. Read, write and edit files, limited to the project folder.

golu-docs.description: Our custom RAG server: search_docs over the local LangChain docs index (fusion retrieval).

context7.description: External resource server: up-to-date docs for thousands of libraries. Works without a key (rate limited); a free key raises the limit.

tavily.description: Optional external server: web search. Set TAVILY_API_KEY in .env and change enabled to true.
